listing.name: Perfect Dark (Perfect Dark: Recompiled)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Perfect Dark: Recompiled; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream reports Defection mission and persistent saves. WSL GPU failures included a host freeze; Windows audio and long sessions remain incompletely tested. Upstream reports Defection mission; Linux WSL Dozen GPU hangs and host freeze, Windows audio only disk driver and short plays; no full-game or physical controller evidence. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux x86-64 and browser. Windows uses D3D12. Linux WSL/Dozen hardware path has serious stability limits. Original data: N64 Perfect Dark USA revision 1, NPDE version 01, 32 MiB ROM, MD5 e03b088b6ac9e0080440efed07c1e40f. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
